families.protected_boundary: Existing completion-report metadata profiles, required sections, source-PR evidence anchors, and unresolved-placeholder rejection. This family has no authority over Documentation Model prose, new-record creation, templates, active-document semantics, or retired-path detection.
families.removal_gate: All existing completion reports are synthesized, reclassified into allowlisted retained records, or retired to Git; no workflow, consolidated smoke group, evaluation runner, operator procedure, or current architecture document consumes the validator; and generic authority, retained-record, link, semantic-audit, and Git-recoverability checks protect every continuing invariant.

families.protected_boundary: Commit-fixed legacy classification, normative candidate extraction, and link-dependency evidence still referenced by unfinished source families.
current_consumers: bounded D2-D6 source-family synthesis and retirement reviews
families.removal_gate: All remaining sources are governed by the canonical active graph, generic normative extraction, generic link checks, and the retirement manifest.

families.protected_boundary: Legacy one-document cutover provenance until its durable fields are represented by the generic retirement manifest or an allowlisted retained record.
families.removal_gate: All continuing recovery or audit facts are represented by allowlisted records, and historical-only narratives remain recoverable from Git.
